error_reason: The Verification_Expert is the decisive error because it explicitly abandoned the core task requirement to extract data from the image and proceeded to calculate statistics on fabricated, assumed data sets instead. This deviation created a false positive calculation (1.445) that masked the underlying tool failures (timeout) and led directly to the incorrect final answer, whereas verifying the data extraction failure would have prevented this fabrication.

hypotheses.rationale: The Verification_Expert is the decisive error because it explicitly abandoned the core task requirement ('Extract the red and green numbers from the image') and proceeded to calculate statistics on fabricated, assumed data instead of the actual image content. This deviation from the task specification created a false positive calculation (1.445) that masked the initial failure to extract data. If the data extraction had been verified as successful, the calculation would have been performed on the correct numbers (yielding ~17.056).

This contradicts the goal of solving the specific image-based problem (Answer: 17.056) and leads to a false calculation (1.445) based on non-existent data.
